card.name: Linking words after drug class nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "of" or "for" right after a drug-class noun like substrates, inhibitors or local anesthetics, just before the specific type or enzyme is named.

modes.label: Substrates/inhibitors of enzyme
modes.description: "of" or "for" after substrates or inhibitors, before a transporter or enzyme name.
modes.example: 7.2 Effects of LISRAYA on Other Drugs Substrates<< of>> P-gp and BCRP B

modes.label: Local anesthetics of the amide type
modes.description: "of" after local anesthetics in contraindication statements, before "the amide type".
modes.example: CONTRAINDICATIONS Diclona™ is contraindicated in patients with a known history of sensitivity to local anesthetics<< of>> the amide type, or to any

modes.label: Inside compound names
modes.description: Final piece of a nutrient or drug name such as folic acid or methionine.
modes.example: Folic<< acid>> antagonists such as pyrimethamine

card.writes: It pushes against words like concentration or presence coming next, favoring a class or type name instead.
card.plain: It marks the little word after a drug group name, where the specific type or enzyme is about to be named.
